review_scope: Independent round-2 review: every material primary source was re-opened over the network on 2026-10-08 and each material numerical/product/version claim compared against the fetched source text and date; the shipped first-party protocol was re-run in isolated scratch and every artifact hash recomputed. Receipt completed with the current article/schema/cover hashes; status set to approved only because the material claims are substantively supported.

run.methodology: python3 test_protocol.py + fixture_report.py run 2026-10-08 on Python 3.12, standard library only, no network/credentials; 10/10 unit tests pass; the synthetic in-memory reference double scores 1.0 on all six measures and each single-defect double drops only its own measure. run_protocol.py emits scores.json carrying the 88 per-item rows plus the six aggregate rates; fixture-tests.txt normalizes only the unittest wall-clock line for reproducibility. Fixture-only harness self-check, never a vendor benchmark.
